scope: Guarded disposable databases only; application DB/env/lock unchanged

red.result: Actual production helper and actual pnpm db:deploy on an initially absent SQLite database under inherited RUST_LOG=warn reproduced blank Schema engine error.

intermediateGreenAttempt.classification: Subprocess ETIMEDOUT at the original 30-second test deadline; no successful or failed semantic assertion established. Deadline increased to the authorized bounded 120 seconds.

assertions: Initially absent SQLite file automatically created by deploySetupDatabase
All 14 repository migration names present, finished, not rolled back
Existing user record unchanged on second deploy
Entire migration catalogue identical on second deploy

cause.explanation: Prisma CLI stderr parser drops first line. At warn logging absent DB emits one P1003 ERROR line, which gets discarded. At info it emits an INFO line first, preserving P1003 and permitting automatic creation.
cause.fix: Only migration subprocess extra environment sets RUST_LOG=info. No SQLite precreation, URL rewrite, global/build/app logging changes.
cause.README: Original failing harness excluded tracked server/data/README.md; corrected harness preserves that marker. The omission was not causal because the wizard creates the data directory.

limits: Unit/native probes do not replace the fresh real-install browser matrix
